shortDescription: Execute SQL statements on an SQLite database.

options.name: db_options
options.description: Additional options passed to the sqlite_utils Database constructor. Useful for advanced database configurations.

options.name: db_path
options.description: Path to the SQLite database. This path should point to an existing database file that is readable.

options.name: params
options.description: Optional parameters for the SQL query. Can be either a list or a dictionary. Helps in preventing SQL injection when used correctly.

options.name: query
options.description: SQL query string to execute. Only one statement is supported.

options.name: sql_method
options.description: Specifies the type of SQL statement to execute.
